mapper.sql: SELECT r.reservation_id::text AS reservation_id, r.operation_id::text AS operation_id, r.reserved_amount, r.tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, r.created_at, i.status, i.run_id::text AS run_id, i.tenant_id::text AS join_tenant_id
mapper.select: FROM budget_reservation r LEFT JOIN agent_invocation i ON i.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND i.invocation_id = r.operation_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND r.state = 'RESERVED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tool_operation o WHERE o.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND o.operation_id = r.operation_id ) ORDER BY r.created_at ASC
